note: Gunnison RD (GMUG): ~9,900 ft at the upper end of Taylor Park on the edge of the pines, ~39.5 mi up Taylor Canyon Rd (CR 742) from Almont; improved dirt past the Cottonwood Pass turnoff, passable by ordinary vehicles. OHV trail network to Taylor Reservoir; the road gets no winter maintenance. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed first-come only, free, vault toilets, no potable water. No recreation.gov listing. No agency site count or length; the FS season line reads only 'Late May', and its current-conditions box talks of winter access ('Be prepared for winter camping'), so season was left as stored. Pin is on the campground loop at the forest edge, ~240 m south of the FS point (which sits at the entrance on the road). Note trimmed.
